lines.text: Mist hangs over @lake_summer, still as glass.
@maya_front walks barefoot to the end of the wooden jetty.
She curls her toes over the edge and breathes in.
She dives. Her body cuts the surface with barely a sound.
The water closes over her. The lake goes quiet.
Ripples spread slowly across the lake toward the far shore.
@maya_front surfaces, laughing, as the last ripple touches the reeds.

writes.note: I drafted a short, visual dive scene from your line, about 14 seconds.

reply.rationale: Built the person's dive and spreading ripples into one location and seven single-beat action lines, about 14 s for the 15 s target, with no dialogue.
